prompt: What could the new sheet show that both old sheets did not consistently show?
promptZh: 新表可以顯示哪項兩翼舊表未一致呈現的資訊？
evidence: only the west sheet also recorded how many pots were watered
one row per pot and a separate column for each visit, including visits when no water is added

options.text: The total number of visits to each wing.
options.whyZh: 兩翼本來都記錄巡查次數。

options.text: A particular pot’s watering history across visits in either wing.
options.zh: 任一翼特定盆栽在各次巡查中的澆水紀錄。
options.why: Rows track each pot; columns capture every visit regardless of watering.
options.whyZh: 每盆一列、每次巡查一欄，不論當次有無澆水都能查。

options.text: The amount spent on water for each planter.
options.why: The new sheet does not isolate water cost.
options.whyZh: 新表不會分出個別水費。

options.text: The number of kitchens in the office.
options.why: Kitchens explain the shared meter; the new sheet tracks pots.
options.whyZh: 廚房用來解釋水表為何共用；新表記錄的是盆栽。
